faq.title: Grok Imagine Image-to-Image FAQ
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about Grok Imagine image-to-image AI tool

q1.question: How many images can I upload?
q1.answer: You upload one image at a time. Describe your transformation in the prompt and generate.

q2.question: How much does it cost?
q2.answer: Each image transformation costs a fixed number of credits. Check the pricing page for current rates.

q3.question: What image formats does Grok Imagine support?
q3.answer: Grok Imagine supports PNG, JPEG, JPG, and WebP formats. Ensure your image is clear and well-lit for optimal results.

q4.question: How should I write prompts for Grok Imagine?
q4.answer: For best results, include detailed descriptions: subject, setting, lighting, style, mood, and composition. More detail typically produces better transformations.

q5.question: Can I transform the same image multiple times?
q5.answer: Yes, you can use different prompts on the same image to get different transformations.
